password.description: Password holds the password to use for client authentication.

password_file.description: PasswordFile points to a file that contains the password. If set, takes precedence over Password. The file is watched for changes.

username.description: Username holds the username to use for client authentication.

username_file.description: UsernameFile points to a file that contains the username. If set, takes precedence over Username. The file is watched for changes.

inline.description: Inline contents of the htpasswd file.
